methodology_note: The review's grading model matches the snapshot and the working-repo verified scorer in every point I checked, and the reviewers consistently re-asked whether each divergence touches a compared table (e.g., closure reasons that only matter through issue_reason when a replacement is ordered, interest-report arguments that persist nothing because TransactionalDB has no interest_discrepancy_reports table). Every Blocker and Major in 077-102 reproduced by replaying gold versus the doc-faithful alternative with a copy of _verified_db_match; no claimed divergence was an artifact of a relaxed table. Blind spots: (1) secondary issues sometimes carry severities off-calibration (task_082 unscripted Blue delivery and task_091 'PIN reset unlocks' gap rated Minor where calibration says Major) without changing task severity; (2) task_082's suggested fix would add a reorder that doc_029's 48-hour ENTRY wait forbids; (3) the review leans on 'free tie' arguments where an explicit documented default (doc_023 CLASSIC) is the stronger basis (task_077, task_090); (4) the liability-timing class is rated Major in 085/086 but not raised in 088 although the same reading decides its stored $50.
fact_observations_from_replay: Confirmed in the snapshot: call_discoverable_agent_tool parses JSON with parse_int=float, and it logs a call when the underlying tool mutates or appears in _read_log_allowlist. A TypeError on bad arguments returns before logging.
generate_agent_discoverable_tool_id uses only the tool name, so repeated calls collapse to one agent_discoverable_tools row.

order_debit_card_5739 sets issue_reason from the FIRST CLOSED card it finds on the account (next(...) over debit_cards in insertion order): lost/stolen kept, fraud_suspected->fraud, any other closure_reason (or a missing one)->first_card. On an account that already holds an older closed card, issue_reason can come from that old card rather than the one just closed. None of the replacement orders in tasks 077-082/090 hit this case.
freeze_debit_card_3892 writes frozen_date and unfreeze_debit_card_3893 writes unfrozen_date. Both persist on cards that end CLOSED, and the verified scorer compares them exactly.
transfer_to_human_agents writes nothing to the DB. request_human_agent_transfer (user tool) writes human_transfer_requests rows, which the scorer compares exactly.

order_replacement_credit_card_7291 accepts only (credit_card_account_id, user_id, shipping_address, reason, expedited_shipping). doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_001 tells agents to pass Shipping_speed / Expedited_fee_acknowledgement / Notes, which raise TypeError and return before logging. That costs a retry but changes no table.

Action.compare_with_tool_call (snapshot src/tau2/data_model/tasks.py:178): with compare_args None it uses the predicted call's argument keys and compares values by equality, so the call_discoverable_agent_tool `arguments` JSON string is compared verbatim; requestor is not compared. Confirmed.
call_discoverable_agent_tool returns 'Error: Invalid arguments' on TypeError before the logging block, so an arg-missing discoverable write logs nothing to agent_discoverable_tools.

order_debit_card_5739 (snapshot tools.py ~3266-3286) sets the new card's issue_reason from the CLOSED card's closure_reason: lost/stolen kept, fraud_suspected->fraud, anything else->first_card. Replays: 088 and 086 close as 'stolen' -> verified False; 084 (no reorder) 'stolen' -> verified True.
close_debit_card_4721 valid reasons are lost, stolen, fraud_suspected, damaged, no_longer_needed, account_closing; 'fraud' is rejected with an error, so the card stays open.
transfer_to_human_agents writes nothing to the DB (088 replay without the transfer passes the verified match).

The verified scorer (_verified_db_match) treats agent_discoverable_tools as a tool-name subset check and strips closure_reason. Every other table (debit_card_disputes, debit_card_orders, debit_cards, verification_history) is compared exactly. Confirmed by the replays above.
